SELECT name, states, max(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many candidates won their general election in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(gen_election AS varchar) = 'W'
What are the most-cited papers in high-energy physics?
SELECT title, try_cast(citation_count AS integer) AS citations FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
In how many hours of 2023 did the real-time price in western New York fall below zero?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name = 'WEST' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double) < 0
Which cities in Texas have the most companies registered to do business with the federal government?
SELECT physical_address_city, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many claims does a published patent application carry on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(pub_clm_ct AS double)), 1) AS avg_claims FROM govblock_patents.claims_pgpub_document_stats
Which states deposited the most into the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2019?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS deposited FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '11-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2019' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average dipole moment of a QM9 molecule?
SELECT avg(mu) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_qm9
At which companies did insiders sell the most stock by value in 2023?

SELECT s.issuername, round(sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(t.trans_pricepershare AS double))) AS dollars_sold FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'S' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in ChEMBL are in phase 3 clinical trials?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 3
Which electric utilities had the most residential customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(customers AS double) AS residential_customers FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How are granted patents divided among the broad technology sectors?

SELECT wipo_sector_title AS sector, count(*) AS patents, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_wipo_technology WHERE cast(wipo_field_sequence AS varchar) = '0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In which states were the most judges born?
SELECT dob_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.people_db_people WHERE dob_state <> '' AND dob_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Democratic or Republican candidates raise more in the 2020 cycle?

SELECT cand_pty_affiliation, sum(ttl_receipts) AS receipts FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2020' AND cand_pty_affiliation IN ('DEM','REP') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
Which wind farms in Iowa have the largest number of turbines?
SELECT p_name, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'IA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much electricity did the United States generate in 2024, in thousand megawatt-hours?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.ALL-US-99.A' AND period = '2024'
What types of patent does the USPTO grant, and how many of each?
SELECT patent_type, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of adverse drug event reports are classed as serious?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN serious = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_event
Which organisations own stakes in the most Medicare nursing facilities?

SELECT organization_name_owner, count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS facilities FROM govblock_health.cms_skilled_nursing_facility_all_owners WHERE type_owner = 'O' AND organization_name_owner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What rate change do Texas personal auto filings ask for on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(replace(percent_change, '%', '') AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_property_casualty_rate_filings WHERE type_of_insurance LIKE 'Personal Auto%'
Which ZIP codes in New York City complain to the FCC the most?
SELECT zip, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'NY' AND city = 'New York' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest hourly real-time power price in New York City in 2022?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone
SELECT max(try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which states had the largest total personal income in 2024?

SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS income_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geofips LIKE '%000' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judicial confirmations were there each year from 2005 to 2014?

SELECT substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2005' AND '2014' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which facilities have made the most event notifications to the NRC?
SELECT facility, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did regulation service cost on average in western New York's real-time market in 2019?
Nyiso As Prices Real Time 5 Min Rtasp
SELECT avg(try_cast(west_regulation_mwhr AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_as_prices_real_time_5_min_rtasp WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2019'
Which states had the most candidates for the U.S. House in 2022?
SELECT cand_office_st, count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'H' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many census tracts are home to more than 5,000 voting-age citizens?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_elections.cvap_tract WHERE lntitle = 'Total' AND try_cast(cvap_est AS double) > 5000
Which utilities cancelled the most nuclear reactors?
SELECT utility, count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_canceled_query_5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average annual pay in Manhattan in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual WHERE area_fips = '36061' AND agglvl_code = '70' AND own_code = '0' AND year = '2023'
What do owners of the 2015 Ford F-150 complain about most?
SELECT compdesc, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'FORD' AND modeltxt = 'F-150' AND cast(yeartxt AS varchar) = '2015' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many leisure and hospitality jobs were lost in spring 2020, and how many are there now?

SELECT year, period, value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES7000000001' AND ((cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period IN ('M02', 'M04')) OR (cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12')) ORDER BY year, period
Which subsidized housing projects in California are the largest?
SELECT name, program_label, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states = 'CA California' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many companies on EDGAR have had their registration revoked?
SELECT count(*) AS revoked FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE flags LIKE '%REVOKED%'
Which parent companies own the most facilities reporting greenhouse gases in 2023?
SELECT parent_company, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.ghg_dim_facility WHERE year = '2023' AND parent_company IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
